How it works

Three steps. That is the whole manual.

  1. 01

    Type

    Say what you want in plain words, like “make a page called Projects”.

  2. 02

    It changes itself

    Menus, pages, layout, theme and skins change in place, right on your stage.

  3. 03

    Undo anything

    Every change is one line with an Undo. Replay the whole session, step by step.

Live today

What you get right now

It edits itself

Ask for a menu, a page, a layout or a new look. The terminal rewrites its own interface and tells you exactly what changed.

  • Menus and pages
  • Layout, theme and skins
  • One click to undo

Tags and structured replies

As you type, words turn into tags: actions, dates, names and lists. A glossary remembers what your words mean. Replies come back as tables and next steps, not walls of text.

Skins that get better

Say “skin the stage mossy stone”. It makes three versions, scores them, keeps the best and tries again, and stops when there is no clear gain.

A library, a koi pond and a canvas

Start from a library of skinned terminals, visit the koi pond, or see every page you have made laid out on one canvas.

Replay every step

Scrub through a session like a video and watch the terminal change. Export a session as a file and import it anywhere.

Sign in only if you want

Sign in with GitHub, Google or email to save your stages to the cloud. Signed out, everything still works, in English or Spanish.

  • Cloud save for your stages
  • Offline? A prompt waits, and you choose to send, edit or discard it when you are back

Every cost shown

The model, the time and the cents. Every time.

Each reply carries one quiet line: which model answered, how long it took and what it cost. Local answers cost nothing. No surprise bill at the end of the month.

Privacy

Private from us by default.

Signed out, your work never leaves your browser. You decide what reaches us, and we say plainly what does.

Your work stays in your browser Live

No account needed. Stages are saved in this browser until you choose to sign in.

Your key never touches our servers Live

With your own OpenRouter key, calls go straight from your browser to OpenRouter.

No trackers Live

These pages load no analytics, no ads and no third-party scripts.

“Share my data” is off Live

A switch in Settings, off by default. Our staff tools only show your stages if you share them or grant access, and you can take it back.

Encrypted with your own key Coming soon

Today privacy is a rule our code keeps. Next, cloud-saved stages encrypted at rest with a key only you hold.
